name: Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Wraps
label: Quest
description: Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Wraps: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Mages in our tribe are known as illusionists. They employ powerful mojo in their incantations, often befuddling and confusing the tribe's enemies!
It is quite the sight to see a powerful illusionist at work, bringing our enemies to their knees from their own madness!
For you to know the way of our illusionists, go to Zul'Gurub and bring back to me selected Paragons of Power. For this, I will give you arm wraps our illusionists use to weave their spells.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend - you've returned already? Were you able to get the Paragons of Power I need?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Impressive... Could you feel the mojo flowing through them? The Paragons of Power were used as currency of sorts back when the Gurubashi Empire ruled these lands. Now we Zandalar will use the latent mojo inside of them to fight the second rise of the Blood God Hakkar!
You've done well today - consider yourself to have a friend in the Zandalar. For that, here are the illusionist's wraps I promised!
